position: A repository decision becomes operational evidence only after the candidate stack passes explicit, short-lived posture checks
headline: Six exact postures can pass while credentials, provider connection, deployment, invitation, and session remain absent.
copy: This is a candidate configuration review, not proof that a live stack exists. Every check expires within twenty-four hours and still needs a later audited execution decision.

postures.title: Identity
postures.copy: No direct identity or participant account.

postures.title: Rights
postures.copy: Only reviewed source material is in scope.

postures.title: Writes
postures.copy: No participant or publication write route.

postures.title: Rollback
postures.copy: A human stop path remains mandatory.

flow.title: Authorize
flow.copy: Start from the bounded v5.1.1 founder decision.

flow.title: Inspect
flow.copy: Check identity, rights, queue, privacy, incident, and rollback posture.

flow.title: Expire
flow.copy: Time-box the evidence to twenty-four hours.

flow.title: Hold
flow.copy: Activate no deployment, provider, invitation, or session.

decisions.label: Named owners
decisions.reason: Operations, privacy, and security stay accountable.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Direct identity fields are rejected by every contract.

locks.title: Execution lock
locks.copy: No invitation, account, credential, participant, or live session is created.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No provider mutation, delivery channel, or exported telemetry exists.

locks.title: Evidence lock
locks.copy: Only fixture evidence and canonical digests are produced.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private evidence review cannot open public access.
